sections.text:
ان أجهزة الذبذبة 
العالية 
Power Line Carrier
على خطوط نقل القدرة بمحطات الكهرباء لا تقل أهمية عن أجهزة 
الوقايات المركبة بتلك المحطات حيث يعتبر عمل هذه الأجهزة مكملا لدور الوقايات. 
ونظرا لأنه عند حدوث قصر على خط الربط بين محطتي كهرباء فإن أجهزة الوقاية بكل محطة 
تعمل على فصل المعدات الموصلة إليها بذات المحطة فقط دون التمكن من فصل معدات 
الجهة الأخرى وبالتالي عند عمل الوقاية بأحد جهتي الربط يستمر الخط قائما 
حتى تقوم 
أجهزة الوقاية 
بجهة الربط التالية بدورها في فصل معداتها لذا كان من الواجب استخدام 
أجهزة الذبذبة العالية 
حتى يتسنى نقل أوامر الفصل بين جهتي الربط دون الانتظار حتي 
تعمل أجهزة الوقاية بجهتي الربط كلا على حدة.

sections_en.text: Power Line Carrier (PLC) equipment on power transmission lines at power stations is no less important than the protection equipment installed at those stations, as the work of this equipment complements the role of protection. Since, when a short circuit occurs on the tie line between two power stations, the protection equipment at each station trips only the equipment connected to it at that same station, without being able to trip the equipment of the other side, then when protection operates at one side of the tie, the line remains in service until the protection equipment at the next tie side plays its role in tripping its equipment. It was therefore necessary to use PLC equipment so that trip commands can be transferred between the two sides of the tie without waiting for the protection equipment at both sides of the tie to operate each on its own.

text_en:
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Communications | Maintenance Procedures
Document Number: PLC-001-r0a | Equipment: Power Line Carrier (PLC) equipment for 132 kV tie lines — AF Tele Protection type 199202, Cegelec
Issued to: Networks
Status: First Draft
Approval Date: | Procedure: Periodic Tests
Date of Next Review:
Introduction
Power Line Carrier (PLC) equipment on power transmission lines at power stations is no less important than the protection equipment installed at those stations, as the work of this equipment complements the role of protection. Since, when a short circuit occurs on the tie line between two power stations, the protection equipment at each station trips only the equipment connected to it at that same station, without being able to trip the equipment of the other side, then when protection operates at one side of the tie, the line remains in service until the protection equipment at the next tie side plays its role in tripping its equipment. It was therefore necessary to use PLC equipment so that trip commands can be transferred between the two sides of the tie without waiting for the protection equipment at both sides of the tie to operate each on its own.
Safety Precautions
Preparation of the work order document
Disconnect the line concerned by the maintenance from both sides and earth it.
Erect a fence around the work place and place the appropriate warning signs.
Put the test switches at both stations of the tie line in test position.
Tools and Instruments Used
Portable air compressor (Blower)
Digital measuring instrument ....
